notes: Solana holder tables used: solana_utils.latest_balances (current state) and solana_utils.daily_balances (historical snapshots). Both queries use COALESCE(token_balance_owner, address) to handle delegated token accounts. AMM/pool exclusion: Filters out token accounts directly owned by 8 known AMM/CLMM/liquidity programs (Orca Whirlpools, Raydium AMM v4/CLMM/CPMM, Meteora DLMM/Pools, Lifinity v2, Phoenix). This is a best-effort exclusion using a curated program list. Residual limitation: Pool token accounts owned by PDAs (program-derived addresses) rather than the program directly are not excluded by this filter. Additional unlisted AMM programs are also not excluded.

concentration.description: Top-N holder share of circulating supply. Returns 2 rows: 'now' (current) and 'baseline' (window_days ago). Value is a 0-1 float representing the fraction of total supply held by the top N holders.

whale_flow.description: Aggregate token balance held by top-N holders. Returns 2 rows: 'now' (current) and 'baseline' (window_days ago). Value is the absolute sum of token balances (not adjusted for decimals - raw on-chain balance).

liquidity.description: DEX pool depth (aggregate vault balances for the mint). Returns 2 rows: 'now' (current) and 'baseline' (latest daily snapshot at/before window_days ago). Value is the sum of token balances across pool vaults.
liquidity.notes: Pool vaults for the liquidity signal are identified positively from dex_solana.trades vaults (complements the AMM program-owner exclusion used by the holder queries).
